fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida Power & Light Company and stock promotion; discussion of extending the Hialeah Jockey Club racing season and a humorous letter about the races; local civic concerns including railroad crossing safety and telephone billing/service disputes; a published petition/letter from prisoners in the Dade County stockade regarding food conditions; society and local-column items, jokes, and extensive advertising for Miami and Miami Beach entertainment venues and businesses.
